propositions: _apply_authorship returns silently when signing_key is configured but author_id is falsy and require_authenticated is off, causing unsigned writes to go undetected
fsck authorship tally is aggregated store-wide into a single uncounted advisory line, hiding per-env unsigned-write patterns (e.g., one env at 0% signed hides behind another at 100%)

AC2: fsck must report as a counted issue any env_id with zero signed events or all events authored Unknown, gated to fire only when the store has adopted signing and that env wrote at or after the first signed event
AC3: _apply_authorship must emit a logger.warning when signing is skipped for lack of resolvable identity or missing signing_key, naming the event uuid and which input was missing
The false measurement of null creation_channel (limb 1) was disproven; production CREATEs carry creation_channel='python'; null reading was a field-path artifact (top-level read vs event data)
beb1 (review bot writing ~8900 unsigned Unknown-authored events) ran undetected for a month due to silent failure at two layers now closed by AC2 and AC3
